title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the last session of 2027, a full equity day carrying an OCC quarterly expiration with no New Year holiday behind it
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), re-fetched direct by this event's own initial research 2026-09-09 UTC (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload, because the 2027 tab is a hidden panel whose text the rendered page drops. The US 2027 panel's final card is a THREE-field card whose middle field is EMPTY: heading 'New Year's Day 2027/2028', date field '' (empty string in the payload), note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, December 31, 2027'. Panel attribution verified first-hand from the surrounding US-only run of cards (Labor Day / Monday, September 6, 2027; Columbus Day / Monday, October 11, 2027; Veterans Day / Thursday, November 11, 2027; Thanksgiving Day / Thursday, November 25, 2027; Christmas Day / Friday, December 24, 2027), and the complete US 2027 early-close list this parse returns is Thu 2027-03-25, Fri 2027-05-28, Fri 2027-07-02, Fri 2027-11-26, Thu 2027-12-23, Fri 2027-12-31. THE EMPTY DATE FIELD IS ITSELF THE CORROBORATION, and it has a dated precedent from SIFMA's own page: the Wayback capture of 2021-12-09 (web.archive.org/web/20211209015548, HTTP 200, 98,305 bytes) shows the identical configuration — Jan 1 falling on a Saturday — rendered as 'New Year's Day 2021/2022' / 'None' / 'Early Close Only (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, December 31, 2021'. So the last time this geometry occurred, SIFMA named NO full close and STILL recommended the year-end early close. NYSE's own holiday table could not be fetched live this session (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars returned HTTP 403 to this runner; recorded in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked) and was read instead from the Wayback capture of 2026-01-06 (HTTP 200, 159,160 bytes): its 2028 New Year's Day cell is an em dash with footnote '* Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed', and its complete early-close footnote set across 2026/2027/2028 names only Mon 2028-07-03, the day after Thanksgiving in all three years, and Thu 2026-12-24 — so there is NO equity early close anywhere in December 2027. Filed estimate on the same three counts every sibling SIFMA entry documents: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has slots for IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA: and none for a trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's closes are recommendations to member firms rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's rule for an id that existed only as a sibling's proposal. The one proposal it shadows — proposals/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-31.from-christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24.json — was read first and stays where it is; every schedule claim above was re-fetched rather than inherited. ONE PROPOSAL CLAIM NARROWED: the proposal called the SIFMA card 'a TWO-field row with NO full-close date' and the christmas-market-closure-2027-12-24 ledger wrote 'the field is absent'. The field is present and EMPTY — the payload carries a third span with children '' — which matters because the 2021 precedent capture writes the literal string 'None' in that same slot, so the empty string is a rendering choice, not a missing record. WHAT THREE THINGS LAND ON THIS SESSION: (1) a full NYSE equity day to 16:00 ET, (2) an OCC 'Quarterly Expiration date' (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes, re-fetched 2026-09-09 and the GUID 812CD242-1E6F-48D4-A1CB-9608ABD8344F resolved against the file's own legend; the same marker sits on 2025-12-31 and 2026-12-31, and the file's range ends at 2027-12-31 so it carries no 2028 rows), and (3) a recommended 14:00 ET fixed-income close. WHAT THIS ENTRY MEASURED THAT NO SIBLING HAD, on Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted daily bars for the last session of each year 1993-2025 against each instrument's own trailing-20-session median: the year-end session does NOT thin the Treasury tape the way the day-after-Thanksgiving half session does. Credit thins decisively (LQD below-normal volume in 19 of 24 years, p = 0.0066, median 0.70x; HYG 15 of 19, p = 0.019, median 0.72x) while Treasury duration does not (TLT 15/24, p = 0.31, median 0.95x; IEF 10/24, median 1.10x; SHY 12/24, median 0.98x) and TIPS runs HEAVIER (TIP above-normal in 17 of 22, p = 0.017, median 1.12x). The move instead lands on the far side of the year boundary: the first session of the new year prints an above-normal |move| in 18 of 24 years for SHY (p = 0.023, median 1.64x) and 17 of 24 for LQD (p = 0.064, median 1.61x), and SHY's year-end print REVERSES on that session in 17 of 23 years (p = 0.035). THE ISSUER'S OWN TREATMENT, from a primary independent of both calendars: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query returns 13 auctions on the last session of the year across 1999-2025 (2001, 2002, 2007, 2018, 2020, 2025 — all bills) alongside 85 settlements, so unlike the day after Thanksgiving this session is NOT auction-free. But every one of those 13 landed Monday-Thursday: across the four FRIDAY year-ends in the window (1999-12-31, 2004-12-31, 2010-12-31, 2021-12-31 — the exact geometry 2027 repeats) Treasury held ZERO auctions. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a recommended early close is not a halt, and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md this session for holiday|christmas|new.?year|half.?day|early.?close|closure|year.?end|santa returns 0 hits in both, so nothing in the house system can fire on this date. HONEST LIMITS: 'rates' is an imperfect kind (EventKind in src/domain/market-events-types.ts has no market-structure member, the same note every sibling records); the NYSE facts are read from a 2026-01-06 archive rather than today's live page, which 403'd; whether CME keeps separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted, no CME source was fetched; and the quarterly-expiration marker is recorded as an attribute of this date, not as a separate proposed event, because this calendar tracks no quarterly-expiration class today. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry. Full ledger: docs/research/events/sifma-bond-early-close-2027-12-31.md
